title: [AUG-172] Research: resizable Default Prompt field in Settings
why_we_need_this: Rodion's feedback (Feature Request 1): the Default Prompt field (transcript processing instructions with {sessionName}, {date}, {duration}) is too small — the whole prompt cannot be seen. Users want to drag the bottom edge to expand it. Source: @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Current field described with file:line refs (component, CSS, height limits) and every place the same prompt editor is used.
- [ ] Options compared: vertical resize handle, auto-grow to content with max height, expand-to-modal — with trade-offs; whether the chosen height should persist.
- [ ] HTML mockup: a self-contained file @docs/mockups/AUG-172/default-prompt.html (opens in a browser, no build) with a working interactive demo of each option (drag handle, auto-grow, expand) using a long real prompt; built on August's real design tokens (frontend-design route, 0 border-radius).
- [ ] Recommendation given; the user picks an option on the mockup (AskUserQuestion); the decision is recorded in this card.
- [ ] CLOSURE CONDITION: an implementation task with the agreed scope, SMART acceptance criteria and a link to the chosen mockup is created on the board; its ID is written into this card and into the roadmap line in @project-context/roadmap/README.md.
important_constraints: Research only — no code changes. Closed only by creating the agreed implementation task. Brutalist design: 0 border-radius (see frontend-design route). Roadmap: M1 Quick fixes. Order: 3/10.
